title: Malthusiasts
html_source:
Refers to Rev. Thomas Robert Malthus FRS who was an English cleric and scholar, influential in the fields of political economy and demography.
The adjective “Malthusian” is used today to describe a pessimistic prediction of the lock-step demise of a humanity doomed to starvation via overpopulation.
